features.source_location: Table 15, physical pp.73–74 / printed pp.58–59; #149 and #522 on physical73
features.strength: Required; Size counts highest object number plus one; entries with object number > Size shall be ignored/missing. #149 rewrites sentence; #522 NOTE says Size does not decrease in updates.
features.implementation: xref::read_xref_stream uses Size for default Index/highest-stated bookkeeping; current classic/xref sections may retain explicit entries above Size by chosen departure.
features.verdict: partial: default/range and departure have separate positive controls. The >Size retention is not conformance; older-object recovery bound remains separately tested.
residuals: Do not treat latest product choice as satisfying Table15 shall-ignore semantics.

features.source_location: Table 15, physical p.73 / printed p.58; Table17 continuation, physical p.82 / printed p.67
features.strength: Optional in Table15 only when multiple sections; direct integer offset. Table17 Prev required when cross-reference streams are already present; in hybrid files not meaningful.
features.ledger: §7.5.5, §7.5.8.2, §7.5.8.4 implemented; current record T90 covers stream-to-stream chain.
features.implementation: read_from_startxref follows direct Prev newest-first; stream and classic sections share chain walker; hybrid stream is consumed before Prev.
features.verdict: covered for ordinary stream Prev and hybrid precedence, subject to recovery policy for malformed offsets.
residuals: Malformed/indirect Prev is not a valid producer case and acceptance/refusal belongs to recovery policy.

features.source_location: Table 15, physical pp.73–74 / printed pp.58–59; Issue #106 physically p74 strikes the Info-row directness phrase.
features.strength: Root required indirect; Encrypt required if encrypted; Info optional, and #106 strikes “shall be an indirect reference” so either direct or indirect dictionary is permitted; ID is required in PDF2 or encrypted, otherwise optional, with two strings of at least 16 bytes. The array and both strings must be direct and unencrypted when Encrypt is present.
features.implementation: Root is resolved by Document::catalog; Information::read and archive Info consumers use Document::get_key and therefore accept either direct values or references; trailer merge carries prior keys.
features.verdict: direct and indirect /Info public metadata routes both pass; the EC3 #106 directness relaxation is now covered.
residuals: No claim that parser validates every Table15 producer condition or PDF-version conditional.

features.source_location: §7.5.4, physical pp.71–73 / printed pp.56–58; no numbered classic-entry table
features.strength: Subsections have first object/count, entries correspond in order; object zero initial free entry; fixed-width records in normative producer format. #109 annotates one-space separators in example/table-style text.
features.ledger: §7.5.4 implemented; aggregate includes documented tolerant token parsing and subsection realignment recovery.
features.implementation: read_classic_table tokenizes rather than fixed-stride parses; each entry maps by subsection position; `realigned` checks a small set of object headers.
features.verdict: valid writer and reader semantics have targeted assertions; tolerant acceptance of nonstandard fixed-width variants is an implementation policy, not evidence producer conditions disappeared.
residuals: Reader need not validate the entire free-list chain to resolve objects; invalid widths/keywords are recovery cases.

features.source_location: §7.5.4, physical pp.71–73 / printed pp.56–58; #147 affects subsection start permission on physical71
features.strength: A free entry states next free object and generation for next reuse; first object in original table is free with generation 65535. Free-list linked topology is writer data; reader resolution uses the free marker.
features.ledger: §7.5.4 plus §7.5.6; free entry as explicit deletion ADR0100/0803
features.implementation: read_classic_table consumes but discards free-entry first/generation fields, retaining `None` by object number; writers emit free-list data and generation updates.
features.verdict: resolved object behavior is covered; generation is taken from the object header when loaded, and free-list traversal is not an object-lookup requirement.
residuals: No full audit of serialized free-list cycle/ordering for every writer.

features.source_location: §7.5.5, physical pp.72–73 / printed pp.57–58; #101 on physical73
features.strength: Final %%EOF and startxref points to beginning of last xref keyword; #101 adds previous xref-stream start to startxref description.

features.source_location: Table 16, physical p.77 / printed p.62; clauses continue physical pp.77–79 / printed pp.62–64; #114/#110/#439 physical77; #594 physical78
features.strength: Type /ObjStm, N, First required; Extends optional and DAG collection relationship. #114 permits ObjStm dictionary entry values direct or indirect uncompressed. #439 excludes catalog in encrypted docs; #110 adds informative interoperability NOTE.
features.ledger: §7.5.7 implemented; producer and reader paths identified
features.implementation: expand_object_stream resolves N/First and stream Length; object_stream_pairs uses First plus N. Extends is not followed for object resolution because xref type-2 entries identify their containing stream directly.

No reader rejection is inferred from writer-only invalid forms.

features.source_location: §7.5.7, physical pp.76–79 / printed pp.61–64; Note6 physical77 / printed62; Note7 physical78 / printed63.
features.strength: N number/relative-offset pairs; offsets increasing; member object-number ordering unrestricted; First identifies first value; each object ends before next offset or stream end; objects values omit obj/endobj; compressed object generation zero; stream itself has xref entry. #594 changes might→may; #110 NOTE; #439 exclusion.

features.source_location: §7.5.8.2, physical pp.81–82 / printed pp.66–67; #246 and #403 on physical81; #720 strikes the remaining indirect-entry exception wording on physical81.
features.strength: Table17 values direct; Index/W array members direct; stream itself unencrypted/no Crypt. After #246 all Table5 common-stream entry values direct, nested array members and dictionary values direct; F prohibited. Entries not in Table5/17 may be indirect; trailer Root remains indirect as Table15 says.
features.implementation: read_xref_stream and decode_direct read raw dict entries without resolving refs, fitting the directness rule required before object table exists.
features.verdict: implementation matches required direct-value read path; tests reviewed do not comprehensively discriminate every directness class. Invalid indirect producer values do not by themselves require a reader error.
residuals: No focused valid xref-stream test for each Table5 direct filter/DecodeParms array/map subvalue; these are invalid when indirect, so no mandatory reject claim.

features.source_location: Table17, physical pp.81–82 / printed pp.66–67; #246/#720 on physical81.
features.strength: Type /XRef, Size, W required; Index optional sorted non-overlapping ranges default [0 Size]; Prev required if older xref streams already in file, not meaningful in hybrid; W required three integers in PDF1.5, second width nonzero; zero width omits field and takes default if specified, first zero defaults type1.
features.implementation: read_xref_stream reads W and Index directly; absent Index maps to [0,Size]; RecordLayout handles absent fields; section traversal follows Prev. Parser accepts some invalid shapes tolerantly.
features.verdict: defaults and valid stream Prev now have exact tests; #500 means absent type1 offset has no default. Some shape constraints are producer-side and parser tolerance is not a conformance claim.
residuals: No complete malformed /Index sorting/overlap and invalid zero-second-W behavior matrix; these are producer restrictions, not a reader-mandated rejection verdict.

features.strength: Type0 free (next-free, generation default0); type1 in-use byte offset and generation default0; type2 compressed stream number and index, stream generation implicitly0; big-endian, widths from W. Unknown types shall mean null. #500 removes type1 offset default 0.
